verses.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਸਦਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: neechahu neech sadhaavanaa gur upadhes kamaavai koiee|

en.bdb: Any rare one practises the Guru's teaching of calling oneself the lowest among the lowly ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਵੀਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੰਮ ਲੈ ਇਕੁ ਰੁਪਈਆ ਹੋਛਾ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: trai veehaa(n) dhe dha(n)m lai ik rupieeaa hochhaa hoiee|

en.bdb: When a rupee is changed into sixty paisas, its power is scattered and it becames weak.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਸੀ ਰੁਪਯੀਂ ਲਈਦਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੁਨਈਆ ਹਉਲਾ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhasee rupayee(n) lieedhaa ik sunieeaa haulaa soiee|

en.bdb: If gold-muhar (coin) is changed for ten rupees, it loses its value.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸੁਨਈਏ ਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਲਯੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਰ ਪਰੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: sahas sunie'ee mul kar layai heeraa haar paroiee|

en.bdb: And if a diamond is obtained for one thousand coins, it becomes so light that it is stringed in a necklace (and is worn).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਖੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi man bach karam bharam bhau khoiee|

en.bdb: The man who by touching the feet and by becoming dust of the feet (of Guru) erases the illusions and fears of speech

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਪੰਚਾਇਣੁ ਪੰਜਿ ਮਾਰ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਰਖਿ ਸਗੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: hoi pa(n)chain pa(n)j maar baahar jaa(n)dhaa rakh sagoiee|

en.bdb: And actions from his mind and in the holy congregation wipes out the five evil propensities, he further restrains the mind
Such a one is a real sadhu (Gurmukh) and his words are ineffable.
